known_limitations: No Wear OS app in this version.
Seasonal themes use code-drawn decor until the owner's pictures are added.
Widgets placed with an earlier version other than the 2x2 now-playing one disappear from the home screen and must be added again.
Romanization does not read Japanese kanji; Hebrew and Arabic show consonants only.
Streaming voice separation does not cover HLS streams.
A listener who picked the Liquid Glass icon before 7.6 is moved to the GTA VI icon like everyone else.
The mobile APK is about 4 MB larger and Lite about 2 MB larger because of the Cast SDK.
Android Auto's queue screen shows only the current song.
Switching between Ketvoice and Ketvoice Lite is a manual install of the other APK.
Ketogether guests hear titles their own sources can play; local files and private titles are shown as unavailable.
Lecture automatique: which queue titles were added automatically is not kept across a session restore.
The mobile and Quest APKs are about 18.6 MB larger because they include the rhythm model.
Launcher icons keep a background: Android fills adaptive icon backgrounds in black.
The signing certificate is the existing public Android debug identity, not a private production key.
